text:
alice: deploy-bot starting staged rollout api-v3.4.2 -> 7% us-west-2. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/3.4.2

deploy-bot: Rollout rb_72134 started: 7% us-west-2. metrics and evals will report in ~90s.

ryan: running quick A/B quality harness now against retrieval-test and summarization-test.

sierra: first batch in: retrieval-test avg cosine drop -0.062 vs baseline (threshold -0.05). samples: https://ci.redwood/evals/72134/samples

ryan: generation p99 +12% but within SLO. quality regression on retriever is the blocker.

deploy-bot: Canary rule triggered: quality_drop <= -0.05 on retrieval-test -> STOP. rb_72134 flagged.

alice: STOP the rollout. do NOT advance. @oncall please check model containers (logs, restarts, kernel warnings).

oncall: checked: one container reported kernel-compat warning and performed a single restart around +30s. no OOMs. mem/cpu normal. sharing logs: https://logs.redwood/containers/72134

sierra: hypothesis: a new kernel selection landed that picks a different attention kernel causing slight numeric drift. options: pin to stable v3.4.1, route canary to quantized fallback v3.4.2-q8, or full rollback.

ryan: pin to v3.4.1 safest for user-facing behaviour. q8 may impact quality unpredictably.

eng-release-lead: decision needed: pin to stable vs full rollback. also consider customer impact and today's change window.

alice: approve temporary pin to api-v3.4.1 at 7% in us-west-2. we'll run extended evals before reattempting. create CS note.

alice: executing command:
```
/deploybot pin --target api-v3.4.1 --region us-west-2 --percent 7 --reason "canary quality regression"
```

deploy-bot: Pin initiated. shifting 7% traffic to api-v3.4.1 in us-west-2. expected completion ~90s. rb_72134 -> pinned

deploy-bot: Pin complete. Traffic pinned to api-v3.4.1 @7% in us-west-2. rb_72134 closed. :white_check_mark:

cs-bot: Drafted customer note in #customer-comms: "Temporary traffic pin to previous version due to canary quality regression; no data loss; investigating." Please review: https://internal.redwood/customer-notes/72134

sierra: opening infra ticket and assigning to runtime + model-onboard. will include kernel selector and preflight regression in CI.

eng-release-lead: rollout paused. reattempt only after kernel fix and green regression run. schedule quick sync tomorrow 11:00 UTC.

alice: thanks everyone. holding further rollout actions until postmortem & mitigations are complete.
